'''Cavill Arin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="TOR" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Jedipedia" /> Balmorran businessman who delivered anti-stealth devices to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] occupation forces to help them reveal stealthed [[Balmorran resistance|resistance fighters]], who used [[Stealth field generator/Legends|stealth technology]] that Arin had built.<ref name="TOR" />
